title: Ironshield tvk.sys IOCTL authorization weaknesses
summary: A published static analysis reports that tvk.sys authorizes clients with a substring check on certificate strings rather than validating the PKCS structure, derives its LEA IOCTL key from code, and builds kernel reads from client-supplied symbol offsets. Documents the reported impact and scope; the vendor did not respond before publication.
affectedVersions: Driver versions described as 1.0.0.165 and a September 17 build identified as 1.0.0.167; no other affected versions are established by the cited analysis.
remediation: The analysis recommends validating PKCS blobs and certificate chains through code-integrity exports such as CiCheckSignedFile, CiValidateFileObject and CiGetCertPublisherName rather than substring matching, treating the transport key as a secret, bounding symbol-derived reads to the intended image, and constraining which process handles an unprivileged caller can obtain. It reports no vendor response, so fix status is unknown here.
